title: A fix round after a round 0 written by code (base copy) sends the document so far and its failure list
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Fix round 1 opens with the first message, the base document and the failure list; fix round 2 continues that conversation; the changes land on the base document.
Calls with a conversation, first calls and calls without a document keep their first message and follow-up.

tests: a fix round after a round 0 written by code opens with the document so far and its failure list; the next fix round continues it
